title: E011-relative stable wide residual datum worth screen
question: Do already cross-fitted E009 legal datum actions retain stable residual value when placed on exact E011, before any new feature selection or model refit is implemented?

placement_grid.selection: For each untouched outer context, choose family, scale, and cap only by pooled row SSE on the complement wells. Ties follow the listed family, scale, and cap order.
placement_grid.final_prediction: Average each well's five repeated-map placed corrections, then add them to exact E011.

special_slice_definitions.long_suffix: well hidden-row count at or above the all-well 80th percentile
special_slice_definitions.high_gr_missingness: well hidden-GR missing fraction at or above the all-well 80th percentile
special_slice_definitions.e011_catastrophe: well E011 RMSE at or above 12.0

negative_controls: deterministically shuffled well actions with seed 16016, using the same nested placement grid
sign-flipped wide64 action using the same nested placement grid
deterministically permuted action-family columns with seed 26016, using the same nested placement grid
if_passed: Write a second preregistration before any feature/model refit. The full stage must compare stable-core selection frequency, coefficient-sign stability, bootstrap/subsample stability, path-evidence-only models, training-only fixed blends, and exact E011 fallback.
if_failed: Close H012/T016 without a new experiment and do not retune scales, caps, feature counts, or subgroup-specific rules around the same E009 actions.
controls: exact input presence and source commit
complete repeated and stress context coverage
edge_groups: missing or duplicate action wells rejected
unknown or duplicate OOF row IDs rejected
non-finite target, E011, or action rejected
